cohort: The study compared 3931 women with a malignancy diagnosed at least 1 year before delivery (7176 deliveries) with 1,746,870 other women giving birth in Sweden between 1994 and 2011.
finding: Women with a history of malignant disease before pregnancy exhibited an increased risk of subfertility, use of IVF, and overall pregnancy and delivery complications.
mod_finding: An increased rate of caesarean sections (OR = 1.27, 95% CI 1.20-1.34) and a studied risk of vacuum extraction or forceps delivery were observed in women with a history of malignancy.
